sentences.pattern: the ground is marriage to a Polish citizen
the ground is refugee status, subsidiary protection or humanitarian stay
the ground is a tolerated stay
the ground is work in an occupation desired for the Polish economy
the ground is being a child of a foreigner settled in Poland
the ground is being a child of a Polish citizen in their parental custody
the ground is Polish origin and the will to settle in Poland
the ground is a valid Karta Polaka and the will to settle in Poland
the ground is asylum granted in Poland
none of the law's grounds applies
right before applying the applicant did not stay in Poland for {N:[0-9]+} years without a break on a temporary permit for this marriage
right before applying the applicant stayed in Poland without a break for at least {N:[0-9]+} years on a temporary permit for this marriage
the stay in Poland on this ground has lasted {N:[0-9]+} years without a break
the child was born at another time
the child was born after the parent's permit was granted or while the parent was in Poland on a temporary permit or protection

rules: % Marriage to a Polish citizen: at least 3 years married and at least 2 years' unbroken stay on a marriage permit
fail(married_under_3_years) :- ground(G, marriage), marriage_years(S, N), N < 3.
fail(no_2_years_on_marriage_permit) :- ground(G, marriage), marriage_permit_stay_at_least(S, N), N < 2.
% Refugee status, subsidiary protection or humanitarian stay: at least 5 years' unbroken stay
fail(protection_under_5_years) :- ground(G, protection), stay_years(S, N), N < 5.
% Tolerated stay: at least 10 years' unbroken stay
fail(tolerated_under_10_years) :- ground(G, tolerated), stay_years(S, N), N < 10.
% Desired occupation: no such permit can be granted yet
% Child of a foreigner settled in Poland: must be born at a qualifying time
